main_text.p: tibus quibufdam operam dant, in convalle Lacónicæ regionis clam delitefcant. hanc ipfam in vallem Cina-donem cum gemino milite; quafi ad arcanum aliquod negotium, ablegant. quem comprehenfum equites, cruciatu torquentes, focios conjurationis eliciunt: quos cum ephori litetarum indicio cognoviffent, fub-lato jam Cinadone; nullo tumultus metu jugulave-runt. Autor poft Xenophontem Polyænus libro 2, Stratagematum.
main_text.head: XC.
main_text.p: Quædam quæ fciveris, nefcire; quam quæ nefcie-ris, proruere; tum ad modeftiæ laudem, tum ad fecu-ritatem tutius eft. Multi enim dum fe latere putant, quiefcunt; ad pœnam luendam protrahendi, audent & aut amoliri perniciem omnia turbando, aut non in-ulti perire fatagunt. Sapienter Tiberio, quanquam multi è dómo principis, equitefque ac fenatores, fuf-ten-taffe opibus, juviffe confilii diverentur, haud qua-fitum; Quæ moderatio locum maximè invenit, autoribus tumultuum jam fublatis, nec cauffam inquirendi ne-ceffitate fuggerente. Supra modum placabilis Julius Cæfar, victoria potitus, omnes litteras in fecretis Sci-pionis fcriniis inventas; ne infpectas quidem, combuf-fit. Dio lib. 43. Quam benignitatem præcipuè Anto-nius exaggerans, invidiam apud populum interfecto-ribus ejus movit. lib. 44. Pari manfuetudine, & litera-rum Sertorii aut ad Sertorium abolitione; eodem Dione autore, ufus antea fuerat Pompejus; multifque neceffitatem belli Sertoriani reliquias renovandi adeò. Inerat. Quafe moderationis laude ineptè amicire vo-luit, qui libellos civium fupplices aut æceufatorios, ut fe faftidio alios metu eximeret, omnes in fubjectum amnem projecit. qua negligentiæ culpa iram & arma, fubditorum in fe concitavit. page.notes: Page is a leaf of Latin historical text with heavy marginal damage on the left and right margins; the marginal notes ("Moderata", "anquisitio", "abolita") and the printed numbers in the margins are only partly legible and are not transcribed as notes. Many words in the body are doubtful due to the scan's blur and show-through; they were read as best possible without [?] marking throughout, and should be checked against the original. The page number and catchword are not visible. Text in the right margin and far-left margin was not legible enough to transcribe.
